mapper.select: SELECT COMPANY ,SECTNAME ,CODE ,NAME ,TOISA ,USERID ,PASS ,GRADE ,WONGA FROM SAWON_MST A WHERE 1=1 AND TOISA = '' AND USERID != '' AND A.USERID = #{SID} AND A.PASS = #{SPASS}
SELECT CUSTCD ,CUSTNAME ,OWNER ,SANO ,TELNO ,SOADDR + SUBADDR CUADDR ,PRICEWAY FROM USER_MST WHERE CUSTCD = #{BUSEO}

SELECT program, progname , parm , progkind , newid , userid, prog_info.progid, webid FROM prog_info, user_prog WHERE prog_info.progid = user_prog.progid and user_prog.userid = #{CODE} and prog_info.newid > '0099' and prog_info.chk = 'Y' and webid != '' order by prog_info.newid

SELECT news_key ,groupcd ,groupname ,news_date ,news_time ,title ,content ,end_date ,kind ,team ,filename FROM group_news WHERE groupcd IN ('000000',#{GROUPCD}) AND end_date >= string(today(),"yyyymmdd") ORDER BY news_date desc,news_key desc

SELECT SHOPNO,(SELECT SHOPNAME FROM USER_MST WHERE USER_MST.SHOPNO = MC20_MST.SHOPNO) SHOPNAME, SUM(AMT - MC20_MST.SALEAMT - MC20_MST.BONUSUSE) AMT,SUM(CASHAMT) CASHAMT,SUM(CARDAMT) CARDAMT ,SUM(MC20_MST.SALEAMT + MC20_MST.SAEUNAMT + MC20_MST.BONUSUSE) SALEAMT ,SUM(VISITCNT) VISITCNT FROM MC20_MST WHERE SHOPNO IN (SELECT SHOPNO FROM SHOP_LIST WHERE GROUPNO = #{GROUPNO})
AND MC20_MST.CHDATE = #{SDATE}
AND MC20_MST.CHDATE = DATEFORMAT(GETDATE() ,'YYYYMMDD')
GROUP BY SHOPNO ORDER BY SHOPNO

SELECT CHDATE,SUM(AMT - MC20_MST.SALEAMT - MC20_MST.BONUSUSE) AMT,SUM(CASHAMT) CASHAMT,SUM(CARDAMT) CARDAMT ,SUM(SAEUNAMT) SAEUNAMT,SUM(MC20_MST.SALEAMT + MC20_MST.SAEUNAMT + MC20_MST.BONUSUSE) SALEAMT,SUM(BONUSAMT) BONUSAMT,SUM(BONUSUSE) BONUSUSE,SUM(VISITCNT) VISITCNT FROM MC20_MST WHERE SHOPNO = #{SHOPNO} AND MC20_MST.CHDATE BETWEEN DATEFORMAT(GETDATE() -10 ,'YYYYMMDD') AND DATEFORMAT(GETDATE() ,'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY CHDATE ORDER BY CHDATE DESC
